using System;

    [Fact]
    public void NetworkCONFIG_SET_LogsWarning_WhenClusterPasswordProvidedWithoutUsername()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<RespServerSession>>();
        var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<IStoreWrapper>(); // Assuming interface exists or needs refactor

        // Simulate parseState with cluster-password but no cluster-username
        var parseState = new MockParseState();
        parseState.AddArgument("cluster-password", "testpass");
        session.SetParseState(parseState);

        // Act

        // Assert
        mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.LogWarning("Cluster username is not provided, will use new password with existing username"),
            Times.Once);
    }

    [Fact]

    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<RespServerSession>>();
        var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<IStoreWrapper>();
        var session = new TestRespServerSession(mockLogger.Object, mockStoreWrapper.Object);

        var parseState = new MockParseState();
        parseState.AddArgument("cluster-username", "testuser");
        parseState.AddArgument("cluster-password", "testpass");
        session.SetParseState(parseState);

        // Act

        // Assert - no warning should be logged

            x => x.LogWarning(It.IsAny<string>()),

        // Arrange

        var session = new TestRespServerSession(mockLogger.Object, mockStoreWrapper.Object);

        var parseState = new MockParseState();
        session.SetParseState(parseState);

        // Act
        var result = session.CallNetworkCONFIG_SET();

        // Assert - no warning should be logged
        mockLogger.Verify(
            x => x.LogWarning(It.IsAny<string>()),
            Times.Never);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void NetworkCONFIG_SET_LogsNoWarning_WhenOnlyClusterUsernameProvided()
    {
        // Arrange
        var mockLogger = new Mock<ILogger<RespServerSession>>();
        var mockStoreWrapper = new Mock<IStoreWrapper>();
        var session = new TestRespServerSession(mockLogger.Object, mockStoreWrapper.Object);

        var parseState = new MockParseState();

    private readonly List<(ReadOnlyMemory<byte> key, ReadOnlyMemory<byte> value)> _args = new();

    public void AddArgument(string key, string value)
    {
        _args.Add((System.Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(key), System.Text.Encoding.ASCII.GetBytes(value)));
    }

    public int Count => _args.Count * 2;

    public ReadOnlyMemory<byte> GetArgSliceByRef(int index)
    {
        var argIndex = index / 2;
        return index % 2 == 0 ? _args[argIndex].key : _args[argIndex].value;
    }

    public void CopyFrom(MockParseState other)
    {
        _args.Clear();
        _args.AddRange(other._args);
    }
